svg.title: Yang–Mills v1.1.0 · Figure 6 · The Bit Delivered Twice: Two Kinds And No Third
svg.text: FIGURE 6
THE BIT DELIVERED TWICE: TWO KINDS AND NO THIRD
YANG–MILLS · FORM BY THEOREM, VALUE BY THE ACT · MASTER v1.1.0_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
STEP 10 · THE BIT DELIVERED TWICE, BY ITS TWO KINDS, AND NO THIRD
KIND 1 · THE FORMAL CARGO
The record's value carried to the host's frame. It arrives free, the
antecedent a theorem; it gives existence and the gap in one step; and it is
exactly the sentence.

svg.text: KIND 2 · THE PHYSICAL WITNESS
The colour register of the host's confined fields: a massless confined
excitation carries colour, no free colour is registered, and every confined
field's theory stands. The last three fields are the bit read in the register of
colour, carried as fields, never proved.

svg.text: The two kinds are one bit
The physical witness is a formal cargo, and the
cargo is exactly the sentence.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Two kinds and no third
Every witness of the sentence, in any vocabulary, is
a delivery of both kinds.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: The two refuters
A group with no theory, or a group whose spectrum
has no positive floor, refutes both kinds at once.

svg.text: THE WITNESSES OF THE SUBJECT, TYPED · EACH INSIDE THE BIT, SHORT OF IT, OR LOAD-BEARING
The strong-coupling lattice gap
It holds on the strong sub-frame and stops short of
the continuum: the weak lattice carries both fields
and fails.

svg.text: The cited fields, load-bearing
Without the strong-coupling field or the Wilson field
the lattice gap fails.

confinement; each matter field load-bearing.
